name: Testiny Free
free_limit: Hosted test management Free plan for up to 3 users; includes test cases, plans, runs, executions, reporting, issue-tracker integrations, API keys and 2FA.
watch_out: Free plan has feature and history limitations versus paid tiers; advanced automation, custom fields, unlimited history and enterprise features require upgrades. A separate 21-day paid-feature trial is not the ongoing Free plan. Self-hosted Testiny Server is paid and is not included. No guaranteed support on Free.
